name: CYBR MATERIAL / Fabrication and Physical Studies
provenance: Ten original deterministic procedural materials. No source images, image generation, white-noise bump or upscaling. Not scans.

materials.name: Calacatta Oro / Honed Quarry Slab
materials.description: One procedural 2.8 m slab with narrow shear seams, branching fractures and mineral intergrowth; honed intact finish.

materials.name: Roman Travertine / Honed Vein Cut
materials.description: Fine bed-correlated irregular open pores without painted cavity outlines; shallow honed sedimentary surface.

materials.name: American Walnut / Timeworn
materials.description: Procedural flat-sawn walnut sampled from a radial growth volume, with nonuniform annual rings, diffuse lumen windows, fine rays and shallow worn oil finish.

materials.name: Fumed Oak / Open Grain
materials.description: Procedural rift-cut fumed oak with growth-volume earlywood vessels, finite medullary ray plates, shallow lumen relief and worn low-gloss finish.

materials.name: Champagne Brass / Satin Brushed
materials.description: Intact satin-brushed brass; fine directional tooling and restrained isolated scores.

materials.name: Blackened Steel / Satin Oxide
materials.description: Intact black oxide on satin machined steel; exposed edges are assigned on fabricated meshes.

materials.name: Bone Porcelain / Clear Glaze
materials.description: Clear glaze over warm ivory ceramic; fine firing flow and shallow glaze peel, without random chips.

materials.name: Saddle Leather / Full Grain
materials.description: Fine irregular submillimeter hide grain and follicles; restrained dye variation. Mesh seams and bends describe construction.

materials.name: Lime Plaster / Troweled Skim
materials.description: Overlapping broad trowel passes and polished leading lips with restrained fine aggregate.

materials.name: Natural Linen / Frayed
materials.description: Fine plain flax weave with 120 variable yarns per tile, continuous over-under bending, fibrils, attached slubs and real transparent inter-yarn openings.
